interface.shortDescription: Anti-detection browser automation (Camoufox) for AI agents
interface.longDescription: Browse, search, scrape, and interact with bot-protected sites (Google, Cloudflare, LinkedIn, Reddit) via Camoufox — a Firefox fork that spoils fingerprints at the C++ level. Ships an MCP server exposing 11 tools (create_tab, snapshot, click, type, navigate, scroll, screenshot, evaluate, close_tab, list_tabs, import_cookies) plus a skill that documents the snapshot-first workflow.
